02 — STUDY & CAREER ABROAD

Study and work abroad, with a guide who has walked the path

TrustBridge advises Chinese students and professionals heading overseas. We plan the whole arc — choosing schools, telling your story well, arriving prepared, and turning a degree into a career.

United States Undergraduate and graduate applications, coast to coast.
United Kingdom UCAS applications, personal statements, and interviews.

College application guidance

One-on-one counseling for US and UK applications, from first longlist to final decision.

  • School selection matched to the student's record, goals, and budget
  • Essay and personal-statement coaching — your voice, sharpened
  • Interview preparation with realistic mock interviews
  • A deadline calendar for the whole family — so deadlines never slip through the cracks
  • Pre-departure and settling-in guidance for students and parents

Career consulting

For graduates and professionals building a working life abroad.

  • Career planning: which country, which industry, which next step
  • Résumé and LinkedIn profiles written to local expectations
  • Interview coaching, including cross-cultural communication
  • Guidance on study-to-work pathways and timelines

03 — HEALTH & BEAUTY TRAVEL

Major medical care in Asia's big cities — arranged like a holiday

China's big-city hospitals and dental centers offer advanced treatment, with treatment plans and cost estimates provided before you travel. Korea adds world-renowned aesthetic medicine. We arrange the medical side and the travel side as one seamless trip.

China

Dental care & implants

  • Dental implants, crowns, and bridges
  • Minor and major procedures, planned around one or two trips
  • Routine checkup and cleaning bundled into the same visit
  • Records and X-rays reviewed with the clinic before you fly
China

Complete body checkups

  • Comprehensive routine screening at major big-city hospitals
  • Imaging, labs, and specialist reviews in a single itinerary
  • Your report explained clearly, in English or Chinese
  • Easy to combine with dental work or a family visit
China · Korea

Cosmetic surgery & aesthetics

  • Consultations with reputable clinics in China and Korea
  • Surgical and non-surgical options reviewed honestly
  • Recovery-friendly hotels and a companion on the ground
  • Follow-up check-ins coordinated after you return home

Every health trip includes the travel, too

You focus on your health. We handle everything around it:

  • 5-star hotel stays near your clinic or hospital
  • A local tour guide for the days between appointments
  • Airport pickup and transfers to every appointment
  • Translation and accompaniment at the clinic
  • A written itinerary and cost estimate before you commit

04 — CHINA/DUBAI/JAPAN TOURS

China, Dubai & Japan tours — with a local guide who lives there

We refer you to trusted local guides in each destination and shape the trip around your pace: landmarks without the crowds, restaurants locals actually eat at, and logistics that simply work.

Beijing

The Forbidden City, the Great Wall, hutongs and imperial gardens — a local guide shows you the capital's history and its everyday life, at your pace.

Japan

Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka and beyond. Local guides for first-timers and repeat visitors alike — neighborhoods, food, day trips, and the etiquette that makes Japan easy.

Dubai

The Burj Khalifa, old Dubai's souks, desert evenings, and modern marvels — a local guide connects the skylines to the stories behind them.

New Zealand

Fjords, lakes, and green hills at an unhurried pace. Local guides for the North and South Islands, from Auckland to Milford Sound.

What our guide referrals include

  • Vetted local guides matched to your language and interests
  • A day-by-day itinerary built before you book anything
  • Hotel, transfer, and ticket arrangements on request
  • A bilingual contact back home while you travel

07 — ABOUT TRUSTBRIDGE

Why a bridge?

TrustBridge (信桥) means “a bridge built on trust.” Our clients are Chinese families and professionals whose biggest decisions — a child's university, a new career abroad, serious dental work, a parent's health checkup — happen across borders, in two languages, far from anyone they know.

We stand in the middle of that gap: a U.S.-registered consultancy that advises clients applying to universities in the US and UK, and connects clients to hospitals and clinics in China and Korea, and trusted local guides in Beijing, Japan, Dubai, and New Zealand — and that runs a matchmaking community where North American Chinese families help their children find each other.
